newsitem.title: SWEDEN: 2 Swedes missing after Ethiopian plane crash.
newsitem.headline: 2 Swedes missing after Ethiopian plane crash.

text.p: Two Swedish embassy staff, both women, are missing after Saturday's crash of a hijacked Ethiopian Airlines plane, the Foreign Ministry said on Sunday.
"They are not on the list of survivors," said spokesman Staffan Bjorck. "We now have to wait and see if they are among the deceased."
Bjorck said the two women, who worked at the Swedish embassies in Addis Ababa and Nairobi, had bookings for flight ET961 and were seen at Addis Ababa airport before it took off.
Only 52 of the plane's 175 passengers and crew are known to have survived the crash in the sea near the Comoro Islands.
